Operating since 2006, the organization delivers <cite id="3">Pre-K through 8th-grade academic instruction</cite> grounded in Islamic values [3]. In FY2025, the academy recorded <cite id="1">$3,145,617 in total revenue</cite> [1]. Support for the school qualifies as sadaqah giving [1].
